primaryStyle: calm expert guide with category-manager editorial empathy
readerTakeaway: Shine and tightness can coexist. Notice what is visible and how skin feels, simplify the next choice, and do not treat a guide as a diagnosis.
openingAngle: Begin with the reader who blots their T-zone but still feels uncomfortable after cleansing—without claiming to solve the cause.
brandPov: MyMirror believes that a useful visible-signal read clarifies what to observe before a reader escalates products or labels themselves.
pagePromise: In a few minutes, readers will understand the practical difference between oil and hydration language, what to notice, and when to pause for professional input.

sectionDirections.direction: Answer the apparent contradiction: surface oil and skin comfort are not the same question.
Use a simple comparison table of what readers may observe, not a diagnostic test.
Give a calm simplify-before-escalate decision sequence.
Set boundaries for persistent, painful, or markedly irritated changes.
Close with MyMirror as an optional visible-signal starting point.

judgmentChecks.notes: All language is cosmetic and observational; no product outcome or medical cause is promised.
